description.value: Aroma Indian Restaurant is an award-winning fine-dining Indian restaurant in Port Moody, operated by chef CM Bhatt whose recipes were developed in India's 5-star hotels and refined over 26 years. The restaurant has been recognized with multiple Yelp business excellence awards and was repeatedly voted a favourite for Indian food in the Tri-City News A-List contest. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with an extensive menu of both meat and vegetarian dishes, plus live music on weekends.
